chunks: How (can they be trusted)? If they prevail against you they will neither observe pacts nor good faith with you. They flatter you with their tongues, but their hearts are averse to you, for most of them are iniquitous.
ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the hypocrites mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the political and spiritual duplicity of the Banu Qurayza and other hypocritical factions who broke their treaties with the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It underscores the distinction between outward submission (Islam) and inward faith (Iman), a key theme in understanding the nature of the Munafiqun who offer peace verbally while harboring enmity in their hearts.
